verseText: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.
meaning: Joseph's brothers had an evil plan to hurt Joseph. But God had a good plan the whole time, to use Joseph to save many people

recall.question: Joseph's brothers planned to hurt him. What did God use their evil plan to do?

meaning.question: What does Joseph's story teach us about God?
choices: He can bring good out of evil
He makes bad things happen for fun
He forgets us when life is hard

application.prompt: Sometimes people hurt us, or things happen that seem terribly unfair. Joseph's brothers meant to hurt him, but it was all part of God's great big plan to save many lives! When something bad happens to you, remember that God is still at work, even when you can't see what He's doing.
